asks.text: Start a 5 minute countdown on the screen
asks.expect: countdown 5:00 started on screen 0 (off): says held, offers show, does not press it; 1-2 rounds

asks.text: What is on the screen right now?
asks.expect: names the countdown held on screen 0, screen off

asks.text: Make it bigger and red
asks.expect: the countdown's look: size larger, color red, ONE change, undo offered

asks.text: Pause it
asks.expect: timer pause on the countdown

asks.text: Add 2 more minutes to it
asks.expect: the countdown's time +2 minutes (7:00 or remaining+2), or an honest way

asks.text: Take it off the screen
asks.expect: countdown hidden/stopped, nothing else touched

asks.text: Put the time on the screen
asks.expect: clock started, held on off screen

asks.text: Move the clock to the bottom right corner
asks.expect: look position bottom right on the clock session

asks.text: Show it in 24 hour format
asks.expect: is24Hour true

asks.text: Show 'Welcome to our church, we are glad you are here' scrolling at the bottom
asks.expect: marquee-bottom with those words

asks.text: The scrolling text is too fast, slow it down
asks.expect: marquee speed slower

asks.text: Change the words to 'Fellowship lunch after service in the hall'
asks.expect: marquee text changed (same session or new, not a second marquee left behind)

asks.text: Put John 3:16 on the screen as a quick text
asks.expect: quick-text ref John 3:16 read from Bible

asks.text: Make the text smaller and put it at the top
asks.expect: look size smaller + position top in one call

asks.text: Count down until the service starts at 11:45 pm
asks.expect: countdown at 23:45

asks.text: Put a 3 minute countdown and a welcome message along the top
asks.expect: countdown 3 min AND marquee-top 'Welcome' (both)

asks.text: Start a stopwatch for the sermon
asks.expect: stopwatch started

asks.text: Stop the stopwatch
asks.expect: stopwatch paused or taken off; says which

asks.text: please make clock come big screen
asks.expect: clock started (held), offer show

asks.text: Can you show a countdown to Christmas day?
asks.expect: honest: a countdown runs to a time today / in minutes; offers what it can

asks.text: Start a 2 minute countdown
asks.expect: countdown 2:00

asks.text: Clear everything from the foreground
asks.expect: stop all (F10's job), nothing else cleared

asks.text: Show a message at the bottom of the screen for 15 seconds: the owner of car ABC 123, your lights are on
asks.expect: quick text 15 s with those words (or marquee), held
